How You Can Help

Discover the many ways you can provide support and ease the unexpected financial burden that pediatric cancer can have on a family.

Wren's Wallets

When you choose to sponsor a wallet, you will be giving directly to families battling pediatric cancer at Levine Children’s Hospital or you may direct a wallet to a special child you’d like to support or in honor of a loved one or special milestone event.

Wren loves to make these herself and fills them with $250 in gift cards to alleviate some of the burden of a hospital admission (gas cards, Chick-Fil-A, Panera, Starbucks, Uber/UberEats/Lyft, Walgreens/CVS, Target etc.) and is valued at $250.

Donate

We are dedicated to never stopping our fight for a cure to end childhood cancer. Any donation amount helps!

Give Now

More Ways To Help
Do you have an upcoming birthday, retirement, other milestone to celebrate, or someone you would like to honor with a fundraiser in their name? Facebook and Instagram make personalized fundraisers easy! Simply click “Start Fundraiser,” choose “Wren’s Village” as the recipient, and all donations will go directly and securely to us without any fees. 




Follow us on Facebook and Instagram. We often post current needs from our local children’s oncology social workers or specific family needs within our network. We make care packages such as shower caddies or back massagers, comfort care items for parents with children in the ICU, exercise or relaxation baskets for parents with long inpatient admissions, character bandaids, Play-Doh, Legos, craft items, puzzles, stickers, pajamas in all sizes for patients, and more for clinics and admitted children/teens. We are able to collect financial donations directed specifically to these projects, or requested items can be dropped off/picked up. 




Brandi frequently speaks at team building events, employer philanthropy campaigns, and community groups. She can help your group participate in a meaningful way that fits your needs, whether it’s stuffing wallets, a matching campaign, hosting your own blood drive at your location or Wren’s bloodmobile, or gift card-collecting drive. We have benefited from “round up” campaigns, spirit nights, donation classes at local gyms, “in lieu of gifts” milestone events, and we are always seeking auction items and in-kind skills/services.
